#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
ROOT_DIR="$( cd "$( dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" )" &> /dev/null && pwd )"
BUILD_DIR="${ROOT_DIR}/build"
SRC_DIR="${ROOT_DIR}/src"
LIB_DIR="${BUILD_DIR}/lib"
BIN_DIR="${BUILD_DIR}/bin"
HW_BUILD_DIR="${BUILD_DIR}/hardware"
VERIFICATION_LOGS="${BUILD_DIR}/verification_logs"
ZK_DIR="${BUILD_DIR}/zk"
echo "--- JAIDE OPUS v36 Build Process Initializing ---"
mkdir -p "$LIB_DIR" "$BIN_DIR" "$HW_BUILD_DIR" "$VERIFICATION_LOGS" "$ZK_DIR"
echo "--- Phase 1: Compiling Core Numerics (Zig TensorCore) ---"
zig build-lib -O ReleaseFast --name tensorcore -fPIC -dynamic "${SRC_DIR}/core/tensorcore.zig"
mv libtensorcore.so "${LIB_DIR}/libtensorcore.so"
echo "TensorCore compiled to ${LIB_DIR}/libtensorcore.so"
echo "--- Phase 2: Hardware Synthesis (Clash/SpinalHDL -> Verilog -> Bitstream) ---"
echo "2a. Synthesizing Spiking Operator Core with Clash..."
clash --verilog "${SRC_DIR}/hardware/SpikingOperatorCore.hs" -o "${HW_BUILD_DIR}/spiking_operator.v.dir" -odir "$HW_BUILD_DIR"
echo "2b. Synthesizing FPGA Top Level with SpinalHDL..."
(cd "${SRC_DIR}/hardware" && sbt "runMain jaide.hardware.FPGATop")
mv "${SRC_DIR}/hardware/FPGATop.v" "$HW_BUILD_DIR"
echo "2c. Running Yosys for logic synthesis..."
yosys -p "synth_ecp5 -json ${HW_BUILD_DIR}/jaide_opus_fpga.json" "${HW_BUILD_DIR}/FPGATop.v" "${HW_BUILD_DIR}/spiking_operator.v.dir/SpikingOperatorCore/SpikingOperatorCore.v"
echo "2d. Running nextpnr for place-and-route..."
nextpnr-ecp5 --85k --json "${HW_BUILD_DIR}/jaide_opus_fpga.json" --textcfg "${HW_BUILD_DIR}/jaide_opus_fpga.config" --lpf "${SRC_DIR}/hardware/constraints.pcf"
echo "2e. Generating final bitstream packet..."
ecppack "${HW_BUILD_DIR}/jaide_opus_fpga.config" "${HW_BUILD_DIR}/jaide_opus_fpga.bit"
echo "Hardware synthesis complete. Bitstream at ${HW_BUILD_DIR}/jaide_opus_fpga.bit"
echo "--- Phase 3: Building Polyglot Runtimes & Kernels ---"
echo "3a. Compiling Elixir Actors for Distributed GP-Prior Management..."
(cd "${SRC_DIR}/actors" && mix local.hex --force && mix local.rebar --force && mix deps.get && mix compile)
echo "3b. Compiling Pony Actors for Event-Driven Spike Processing..."
ponyc "${SRC_DIR}/actors/worker.pony" -o "${BIN_DIR}/pony_worker"
echo "3c. Building Gleam Data Pipelines..."
(cd "${SRC_DIR}/runtime" && gleam build)
echo "3d. Compiling Chapel Parallel Kernels for Dimension-Aware Learning..."
chpl "${SRC_DIR}/parallel/orchestrator.chpl" -o "${BIN_DIR}/chapel_orchestrator" --fast
echo "3e. Compiling Futhark GPU Kernels for Operator Integrals..."
futhark zig "${SRC_DIR}/parallel/kernels.fut" -o "${SRC_DIR}/parallel/futhark_kernel.zig"
(cd "${SRC_DIR}/parallel" && zig build-lib -O ReleaseFast -fPIC -dynamic futhark_kernel.zig -lc)
mv "${SRC_DIR}/parallel/libfuthark_kernel.so" "$LIB_DIR"
echo "3f. Compiling Nim Scheduler for Task Graph Execution..."
nim c --opt:speed --threads:on --out:"${BIN_DIR}/scheduler" "${SRC_DIR}/runtime/scheduler.nim"
echo "3g. Compiling Haskell Verification Modules..."
ghc -o "${BIN_DIR}/haskell_verifier" "${SRC_DIR}/verification/haskell/Verifier.hs" -O2
echo "3h. Compiling OCaml Inference Engine..."
ocamlopt -o "${BIN_DIR}/ocaml_inference" "${SRC_DIR}/inference/engine.ml" -O3
echo "3i. Compiling Scala Akka Actors for Scaling..."
(cd "${SRC_DIR}/actors/scala" && sbt compile)
echo "3j. Compiling Julia Parallel Modules..."
julia -e 'using Pkg; Pkg.add("Distributed"); Pkg.precompile()' && julia "${SRC_DIR}/parallel/julia_parallel.jl" > /dev/null
echo "3k. Compiling Go Runtime Coordinator..."
go build -o "${BIN_DIR}/go_coordinator" "${SRC_DIR}/runtime/coordinator.go"
echo "3l. Compiling C++ Spike Simulator..."
g++ -o "${BIN_DIR}/cpp_spike_sim" "${SRC_DIR}/core/spike_sim.cpp" -O3 -std=c++20 -pthread
echo "3m. Compiling Lisp Symbolic Verifier..."
sbcl --load "${SRC_DIR}/verification/lisp/symbolic.lisp" --quit
echo "3n. Compiling Prolog Logic Checker..."
swipl -g "consult('${SRC_DIR}/verification/prolog/logic.pl'), halt." -t halt
echo "3o. Compiling R Statistical Analyzer..."
Rscript "${SRC_DIR}/analysis/stats.R" > /dev/null
echo "3p. Compiling Fortran Matrix Routines..."
gfortran -o "${BIN_DIR}/fortran_matrix" "${SRC_DIR}/core/matrix.f90" -O3 -lblas -llapack
echo "3q. Compiling Ada Safety Modules..."
gnatmake -o "${BIN_DIR}/ada_safety" "${SRC_DIR}/safety/main.adb" -O3
echo "3r. Compiling D Language Utilities..."
dmd -of="${BIN_DIR}/d_utils" "${SRC_DIR}/utils/main.d" -release -O
echo "3s. Compiling Crystal Web Interface..."
crystal build "${SRC_DIR}/interface/web.cr" -o "${BIN_DIR}/crystal_web" --release
echo "3t. Compiling Elixir Phoenix API..."
(cd "${SRC_DIR}/api" && mix phx.gen.release)
echo "--- Phase 4: Generating Zero-Knowledge Proof Keys ---"
echo "4a. Compiling Circom circuit for OPUS uncertainty bounds..."
circom "${SRC_DIR}/quantum/verification_proof.circom" --r1cs --wasm --sym -o "$ZK_DIR"
echo "4b. Generating trusted setup (dummy phase 1)..."
(cd "$ZK_DIR" && snarkjs powersoftau new bn128 14 pot14_0000.ptau -v)
(cd "$ZK_DIR" && echo "jaide_opus_entropy_$(date +%s)" | snarkjs powersoftau contribute pot14_0000.ptau pot14_0001.ptau --name="JAIDE OPUS Initial Contribution" -v)
(cd "$ZK_DIR" && snarkjs powersoftau prepare phase2 pot14_0001.ptau pot14_final.ptau -v)
echo "4c. Generating proving and verification keys (phase 2)..."
(cd "$ZK_DIR" && snarkjs groth16 setup verification_proof.r1cs pot14_final.ptau verification_proof_0000.zkey)
(cd "$ZK_DIR" && echo "jaide_opus_final_key_entropy_$(date +%s)" | snarkjs zkey contribute verification_proof_0000.zkey verification_proof_0001.zkey --name="JAIDE OPUS Final Key" -v)
(cd "$ZK_DIR" && snarkjs zkey export verificationkey verification_proof_0001.zkey verification_key.json)
echo "ZK keys generated in $ZK_DIR"
echo "4d. Compiling additional ZK circuits for spiking integrity..."
circom "${SRC_DIR}/quantum/spiking_integrity.circom" --r1cs --wasm --sym -o "$ZK_DIR/spiking"
(cd "$ZK_DIR/spiking" && snarkjs groth16 setup spiking_integrity.r1cs ../pot14_final.ptau spiking_integrity_0000.zkey)
(cd "$ZK_DIR/spiking" && echo "spiking_entropy_$(date +%s)" | snarkjs zkey contribute spiking_integrity_0000.zkey spiking_integrity_0001.zkey --name="Spiking Integrity Key" -v)
(cd "$ZK_DIR/spiking" && snarkjs zkey export verificationkey spiking_integrity_0001.zkey spiking_verification_key.json)
echo "4e. Generating ZK for GP prior convergence..."
circom "${SRC_DIR}/quantum/gp_convergence.circom" --r1cs --wasm --sym -o "$ZK_DIR/gp"
(cd "$ZK_DIR/gp" && snarkjs groth16 setup gp_convergence.r1cs ../pot14_final.ptau gp_convergence_0000.zkey)
(cd "$ZK_DIR/gp" && echo "gp_entropy_$(date +%s)" | snarkjs zkey contribute gp_convergence_0000.zkey gp_convergence_0001.zkey --name="GP Convergence Key" -v)
(cd "$ZK_DIR/gp" && snarkjs zkey export verificationkey gp_convergence_0001.zkey gp_verification_key.json)
echo "--- Phase 5: Running Full Formal Verification Suite ---"
echo "5a. Verifying with Lean4 (GP-Prior Convergence)..."
lean "${SRC_DIR}/verification/lean/OptimizerInvariants.lean" > "${VERIFICATION_LOGS}/lean.log" 2>&1
echo "5b. Verifying with Isabelle/HOL (Spike-Time Encoding Harmony)..."
isabelle build -d "${SRC_DIR}/verification/isabelle" -b VocabularyHarmony > "${VERIFICATION_LOGS}/isabelle.log" 2>&1
echo "5c. Verifying with Agda (Dimension-Aware Type System)..."
agda "${SRC_DIR}/verification/agda/TensorTypes.agda" > "${VERIFICATION_LOGS}/agda.log" 2>&1
echo "5d. Verifying with Viper (Memory Safety)..."
viperserver "${SRC_DIR}/verification/viper/MemorySafety.vpr" > "${VERIFICATION_LOGS}/viper.log" 2>&1 || true
echo "5e. Verifying with TLA+ (Distributed Consensus)..."
tlc -config "${SRC_DIR}/verification/tla/DistributedConsensus.cfg" "${SRC_DIR}/verification/tla/DistributedConsensus.tla" > "${VERIFICATION_LOGS}/tla.log" 2>&1
echo "5f. Verifying with Spin/Promela (IPC Protocol)..."
(cd "${SRC_DIR}/verification/spin" && spin -a IPCProtocol.pml && gcc -o pan pan.c && ./pan -a > "${VERIFICATION_LOGS}/spin.log" 2>&1 && rm -f pan pan.c pan.b pan.p pan.t)
echo "5g. Verifying with K Framework (Proof Semantics)..."
krun "${SRC_DIR}/verification/k/ProofSemantics.k" > "${VERIFICATION_LOGS}/k.log" 2>&1
echo "5h. Verifying with Vale (Secure IPC Parser)..."
(cd "${SRC_DIR}/verification/vale" && vale SecureIPCParser.vale > "${VERIFICATION_LOGS}/vale.log" 2>&1)
echo "5i. Verifying with Coq (Mathematical Foundations)..."
coqc "${SRC_DIR}/verification/coq/Foundations.v" > "${VERIFICATION_LOGS}/coq.log" 2>&1
echo "5j. Verifying with F* (Security Properties)..."
fstar "${SRC_DIR}/verification/fstar/Security.fst" > "${VERIFICATION_LOGS}/fstar.log" 2>&1
echo "5k. Verifying with Why3 (Algorithm Correctness)..."
why3 prove "${SRC_DIR}/verification/why3/Correctness.mlw" > "${VERIFICATION_LOGS}/why3.log" 2>&1
echo "5l. Verifying with Z3 (SMT Constraints)..."
z3 "${SRC_DIR}/verification/z3/constraints.smt2" > "${VERIFICATION_LOGS}/z3.log" 2>&1
echo "5m. Verifying with CVC5 (Quantified Logic)..."
cvc5 "${SRC_DIR}/verification/cvc5/logic.smt" > "${VERIFICATION_LOGS}/cvc5.log" 2>&1
echo "5n. Verifying with Alloy (Model Checking)..."
alloy "${SRC_DIR}/verification/alloy/model.als" > "${VERIFICATION_LOGS}/alloy.log" 2>&1
echo "5o. Verifying with NuSMV (Temporal Logic)..."
nusmv "${SRC_DIR}/verification/nusmv/temporal.smv" > "${VERIFICATION_LOGS}/nusmv.log" 2>&1
echo "5p. Verifying with CBMC (Bounded Model Checking)..."
cbmc "${SRC_DIR}/verification/cbmc/bounded.c" > "${VERIFICATION_LOGS}/cbmc.log" 2>&1
echo "5q. Verifying with SPARK (Ada Contracts)..."
gnatprove -P "${SRC_DIR}/verification/spark/project.gpr" > "${VERIFICATION_LOGS}/spark.log" 2>&1
echo "5r. Verifying with Dafny (Verification Language)..."
dafny "${SRC_DIR}/verification/dafny/program.dfy" > "${VERIFICATION_LOGS}/dafny.log" 2>&1
echo "5s. Verifying with VST (Verified Software Toolchain)..."
make -C "${SRC_DIR}/verification/vst" > "${VERIFICATION_LOGS}/vst.log" 2>&1
echo "--- Phase 6: Setup Modal.com Environment & Deployment ---"
echo "Setting up Modal environment..."
export MODAL_API_KEY=$(cat modal.key.txt)
export IBM_QUANTUM_CRN="crn:v1:bluemix:public:quantum-computing:us-east:a/da943182c7154fd1a40b6ec751aca550:c8031647-2058-4715-b023-55a1dd71454f"
echo "Building Docker image for Modal (8xB200 GPUs)..."
docker build -f Dockerfile.gpu -t jaide-opus-training:latest .
echo "Pushing to a temporary registry (replace with your own)..."
docker tag jaide-opus-training:latest my-registry.example.com/jaide-opus-v36
docker push my-registry.example.com/jaide-opus-v36
echo "Deploying to Modal..."
modal deploy modal_deployment.yaml

const std = @import("std");

pub const Tensor = struct {
    allocator: Allocator,

    data: []f32,
    grad: ?[]f32 = null,
    requires_grad: bool = false,
    pub fn init(allocator: Allocator, shape: []const u32) !Tensor {
        var size: u64 = 1;
        for (shape) |d| {
            size *= d;
        }
        const data = try allocator.alloc(f32, size);
        @memset(data, 0.0);
        return Tensor{
            .allocator = allocator,
            .shape = try allocator.dupe(u32, shape),
            .data = data,

    }
    pub fn deinit(self: *Tensor) void {
        self.allocator.free(self.shape);
        self.allocator.free(self.data);

        self.* = undefined;
    }
    pub fn getIndex(self: *const Tensor, indices: []const u32) !usize {
        if (indices.len != self.shape.len) return error.ShapeMismatch;
        var index: usize = 0;
        var stride: usize = 1;
        var i: usize = self.shape.len;
        while (i > 0) {
            i -= 1;

            index += indices[i] * stride;
            stride *= self.shape[i];
        }
        return index;

    pub fn get(self: *const Tensor, indices: []const u32) !f32 {
        const index = try self.getIndex(indices);
        return self.data[index];

    pub fn set(self: *Tensor, indices: []const u32, value: f32) !void {
        const index = try self.getIndex(indices);
        self.data[index] = value;

    pub fn add(self: *const Tensor, other: *const Tensor) !Tensor {

        for (0..self.data.len) |i| {
            result.data[i] = self.data[i] + other.data[i];

        return result;
    }
    pub fn sub(self: *const Tensor, other: *const Tensor) !Tensor {

        var result = try Tensor.init(self.allocator, self.shape);
        for (0..self.data.len) |i| {
            result.data[i] = self.data[i] - other.data[i];
        }
        return result;
    }
    pub fn mul(self: *const Tensor, other: *const Tensor) !Tensor {

        var result = try Tensor.init(self.allocator, self.shape);
        for (0..self.data.len) |i| {
            result.data[i] = self.data[i] * other.data[i];
        }
        return result;
    }
    pub fn div(self: *const Tensor, other: *const Tensor) !Tensor {

        var result = try Tensor.init(self.allocator, self.shape);
        for (0..self.data.len) |i| {
            if (other.data[i] == 0) return error.DivisionByZero;
            result.data[i] = self.data[i] / other.data[i];
        }
        return result;
    }
    pub fn matmul(allocator: Allocator, a: *const Tensor, b: *const Tensor) !Tensor {
        if (a.shape.len != 2 or b.shape.len != 2 or a.shape[1] != b.shape[0]) {
            return error.MatmulShapeMismatch;
        }
        const M = a.shape[0];
        const K = a.shape[1];
        const N = b.shape[1];
        var c = try Tensor.init(allocator, &.{ M, N });
        @memset(c.data, 0.0);
        for (0..M) |i| {
            for (0..N) |j| {
                var sum: f32 = 0.0;
                for (0..K) |k| {

    }

        for (0..self.shape[0]) |i| {
            for (0..self.shape[1]) |j| {
                result.data[j * self.shape[0] + i] = self.data[i * self.shape[1] + j];

        return result;

    pub fn relu(self: *const Tensor) !Tensor {

    }
    pub fn sigmoid(self: *const Tensor) !Tensor {

        return result;
    }
    pub fn tanh(self: *const Tensor) !Tensor {

            result.data[i] = math.tanh(self.data[i]);

    pub fn softmax(t: *Tensor, axis: u32) !void {

        const rows = t.shape[0];
        const cols = t.shape[1];
        if (axis == 1) {
            for (0..rows) |i| {
                const row_start = i * cols;
                const row_slice = t.data[row_start .. row_start + cols];
                var max_val = row_slice[0];
                for (1..cols) |j| {
                    if (row_slice[j] > max_val) max_val = row_slice[j];
                }
                var sum_exp: f32 = 0.0;
                for (0..cols) |j| {
                    const exp_val = math.exp(row_slice[j] - max_val);
                    row_slice[j] = exp_val;
                    sum_exp += exp_val;
                }
                for (0..cols) |j| {
                    row_slice[j] /= sum_exp;
                }
            }
        } else {
            for (0..cols) |j| {
                var max_val: f32 = t.data[j];
                for (1..rows) |i| {
                    const val = t.data[i * cols + j];
                    if (val > max_val) max_val = val;
                }
                var sum_exp: f32 = 0.0;
                for (0..rows) |i| {
                    const exp_val = math.exp(t.data[i * cols + j] - max_val);
                    t.data[i * cols + j] = exp_val;
                    sum_exp += exp_val;

                    t.data[i * cols + j] /= sum_exp;

    pub fn layerNorm(t: *Tensor, epsilon: f32) !void {
        if (t.shape.len != 2) return error.NotImplementedForShape;
        const rows = t.shape[0];
        const cols = t.shape[1];
        for (0..rows) |i| {
            const row_start = i * cols;
            const row_slice = t.data[row_start .. row_start + cols];
            var mean: f32 = 0.0;
            for (row_slice) |val| mean += val;
            mean /= @as(f32, @floatFromInt(cols));
            var variance: f32 = 0.0;
            for (row_slice) |val| {
                const diff = val - mean;
                variance += diff * diff;
            }
            variance /= @as(f32, @floatFromInt(cols));
            const inv_stddev = 1.0 / math.sqrt(variance + epsilon);
            for (row_slice) |*val| {
                *val = (*val - mean) * inv_stddev;
            }
        }

        const n = t.shape[0];
        var b = try Tensor.init(allocator, &.{n});
        defer b.deinit();
        var prng = std.rand.DefaultPrng.init(0);
        const rand = prng.random();
        for (0..n) |i| {
            b.data[i] = rand.float(f32);
        }
        var b_norm: f32 = 0.0;
        for (b.data) |val| b_norm += val * val;
        b_norm = math.sqrt(b_norm);
        for (b.data) |*val| val.* /= b_norm;
        for (0..max_iter) |_| {
            var ab = try matmul(allocator, t, &b);
            defer ab.deinit();
            var norm: f32 = 0.0;
            for (ab.data) |val| norm += val * val;
            norm = math.sqrt(norm);
            for (0..n) |i| {

        }
        var ab_final = try matmul(allocator, t, &b);
        defer ab_final.deinit();
        var result: f32 = 0.0;

const std = @import("std");
const math = std.math;
const mem = std.mem;
const testing = std.testing;
const Allocator = mem.Allocator;

pub const Tensor = struct {
    allocator: Allocator,
    shape: []const u32,
    data: []f32,
    grad: ?[]f32 = null,
    requires_grad: bool = false,

    pub fn init(allocator: Allocator, shape: []const u32) !Tensor {
        var size: usize = 1;
        for (shape) |d| {
            size *= @as(usize, d);
        }
        const data = try allocator.alloc(f32, size);
        mem.set(f32, data, 0.0);
        return Tensor{
            .allocator = allocator,
            .shape = try allocator.dupe(u32, shape),
            .data = data,
        };
    }

    pub fn deinit(self: *Tensor) void {
        self.allocator.free(self.shape);
        self.allocator.free(self.data);
        if (self.grad) |g| {
            self.allocator.free(g);
        }
        self.* = undefined;

    pub fn getIndex(self: *const Tensor, indices: []const u32) !usize {
        if (indices.len != self.shape.len) return error.ShapeMismatch;
        var index: usize = 0;
        var stride: usize = 1;
        var i: usize = self.shape.len;
        while (i > 0) {
            i -= 1;
            if (indices[i] >= self.shape[i]) return error.IndexOutOfBounds;
            index += @as(usize, indices[i]) * stride;
            stride *= @as(usize, self.shape[i]);
        }
        return index;
    }

    pub fn get(self: *const Tensor, indices: []const u32) !f32 {
        const index = try self.getIndex(indices);
        return self.data[index];
    }

    pub fn set(self: *Tensor, indices: []const u32, value: f32) !void {
        const index = try self.getIndex(indices);
        self.data[index] = value;
    }

    pub fn add(self: *const Tensor, other: *const Tensor) !Tensor {
        if (!mem.eql(u32, self.shape, other.shape)) return error.ShapeMismatch;
        var result = try Tensor.init(self.allocator, self.shape);
        for (self.data, 0..) |_, i| {
            result.data[i] = self.data[i] + other.data[i];

        return result;

    pub fn sub(self: *const Tensor, other: *const Tensor) !Tensor {

    pub fn matmul(allocator: Allocator, a: *const Tensor, b: *const Tensor) !Tensor {
        if (a.shape.len != 2 or b.shape.len != 2 or a.shape[1] != b.shape[0]) {
            return error.MatmulShapeMismatch;
        }
        const M_u32 = a.shape[0];
        const K_u32 = a.shape[1];
        const N_u32 = b.shape[1];
        const M: usize = @as(usize, M_u32);
        const K: usize = @as(usize, K_u32);
        const N: usize = @as(usize, N_u32);
        var out_shape: [2]u32 = .{ @as(u32, @intCast(M)), @as(u32, @intCast(N)) };
        var c = try Tensor.init(allocator, out_shape[0..]);
        mem.set(f32, c.data, 0.0);
        var i: usize = 0;
        while (i < M) : (i += 1) {
            var j: usize = 0;
            while (j < N) : (j += 1) {
                var sum: f32 = 0.0;
                var k: usize = 0;
                while (k < K) : (k += 1) {
                    sum += a.data[i * K + k] * b.data[k * N + j];
                }
                c.data[i * N + j] = sum;
            }
        }
        return c;
    }

    pub fn transpose(self: *const Tensor) !Tensor {
        if (self.shape.len != 2) return error.NotImplementedForShape;
        var result_shape: [2]u32 = .{ self.shape[1], self.shape[0] };
        var result = try Tensor.init(self.allocator, result_shape[0..]);
        const rows: usize = @as(usize, self.shape[0]);
        const cols: usize = @as(usize, self.shape[1]);
        var i: usize = 0;
        while (i < rows) : (i += 1) {
            var j: usize = 0;
            while (j < cols) : (j += 1) {
                result.data[j * rows + i] = self.data[i * cols + j];
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    pub fn relu(self: *const Tensor) !Tensor {

    pub fn softmax(t: *Tensor, axis: u32) !void {
        if (axis >= t.shape.len) return error.InvalidAxis;
        if (t.shape.len != 2) return error.NotImplementedForShape;
        const rows: usize = @as(usize, t.shape[0]);
        const cols: usize = @as(usize, t.shape[1]);
        if (axis == 1) {
            var i: usize = 0;
            while (i < rows) : (i += 1) {
                const row_start = i * cols;
                const row_slice = t.data[row_start .. row_start + cols];
                var max_val = row_slice[0];
                var j: usize = 1;
                while (j < cols) : (j += 1) {
                    if (row_slice[j] > max_val) max_val = row_slice[j];
                }
                var sum_exp: f32 = 0.0;
                j = 0;
                while (j < cols) : (j += 1) {
                    const exp_val = math.exp(row_slice[j] - max_val);
                    row_slice[j] = exp_val;
                    sum_exp += exp_val;
                }
                j = 0;
                while (j < cols) : (j += 1) {
                    row_slice[j] /= sum_exp;
                }
            }
        } else {
            var j: usize = 0;
            while (j < cols) : (j += 1) {
                var max_val: f32 = t.data[j];
                var i: usize = 1;
                while (i < rows) : (i += 1) {
                    const val = t.data[i * cols + j];
                    if (val > max_val) max_val = val;
                }
                var sum_exp: f32 = 0.0;
                i = 0;
                while (i < rows) : (i += 1) {
                    const exp_val = math.exp(t.data[i * cols + j] - max_val);
                    t.data[i * cols + j] = exp_val;
                    sum_exp += exp_val;
                }
                i = 0;
                while (i < rows) : (i += 1) {
                    t.data[i * cols + j] /= sum_exp;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    pub fn layerNorm(t: *Tensor, epsilon: f32) !void {
        if (t.shape.len != 2) return error.NotImplementedForShape;
        const rows: usize = @as(usize, t.shape[0]);
        const cols: usize = @as(usize, t.shape[1]);
        var i: usize = 0;
        while (i < rows) : (i += 1) {
            const row_start = i * cols;
            const row_slice = t.data[row_start .. row_start + cols];
            var mean: f32 = 0.0;
            for (row_slice) |val| mean += val;
            mean /= @as(f32, @floatFromInt(cols));
            var variance: f32 = 0.0;
            for (row_slice) |val| {
                const diff = val - mean;
                variance += diff * diff;
            }
            variance /= @as(f32, @floatFromInt(cols));
            const inv_stddev = 1.0 / math.sqrt(variance + epsilon);
            for (row_slice) |*val| {
                val.* = (val.* - mean) * inv_stddev;
            }
        }
    }

    pub fn conv2d(allocator: Allocator, input: *const Tensor, kernel: *const Tensor, stride: u32, padding: u32) !Tensor {
        if (input.shape.len != 4 or kernel.shape.len != 4) return error.InvalidShapeForConv;
        const batch_u32 = input.shape[0];
        const in_channels_u32 = input.shape[1];
        const height_u32 = input.shape[2];
        const width_u32 = input.shape[3];
        const out_channels_u32 = kernel.shape[0];
        const kernel_height_u32 = kernel.shape[2];
        const kernel_width_u32 = kernel.shape[3];
        if (in_channels_u32 != kernel.shape[1]) return error.ChannelMismatch;
        if (stride == 0) return error.InvalidStride;
        const out_height_u32: u32 = (height_u32 + 2 * padding - kernel_height_u32) / stride + 1;
        const out_width_u32: u32 = (width_u32 + 2 * padding - kernel_width_u32) / stride + 1;
        var out_shape: [4]u32 = .{ batch_u32, out_channels_u32, out_height_u32, out_width_u32 };
        var pad_shape: [4]u32 = .{ batch_u32, in_channels_u32, height_u32 + 2 * padding, width_u32 + 2 * padding };
        var output = try Tensor.init(allocator, out_shape[0..]);
        mem.set(f32, output.data, 0.0);
        var padded_input = try Tensor.init(allocator, pad_shape[0..]);
        defer padded_input.deinit();
        mem.set(f32, padded_input.data, 0.0);

        const batch: usize = @as(usize, batch_u32);
        const in_channels: usize = @as(usize, in_channels_u32);
        const height: usize = @as(usize, height_u32);
        const width: usize = @as(usize, width_u32);
        const out_channels: usize = @as(usize, out_channels_u32);
        const kernel_height: usize = @as(usize, kernel_height_u32);
        const kernel_width: usize = @as(usize, kernel_width_u32);
        const pad_h: usize = @as(usize, padding);
        const pad_w: usize = @as(usize, padding);
        const padded_h: usize = height + 2 * pad_h;
        const padded_w: usize = width + 2 * pad_w;
        const out_height: usize = @as(usize, out_height_u32);
        const out_width: usize = @as(usize, out_width_u32);
        const stride_usize: usize = @as(usize, stride);

        var b: usize = 0;
        while (b < batch) : (b += 1) {
            var c: usize = 0;
            while (c < in_channels) : (c += 1) {
                var h: usize = 0;
                while (h < height) : (h += 1) {
                    var w: usize = 0;
                    while (w < width) : (w += 1) {
                        const idx_in = b * in_channels * height * width + c * height * width + h * width + w;
                        const idx_pad = b * in_channels * padded_h * padded_w + c * padded_h * padded_w + (h + pad_h) * padded_w + (w + pad_w);
                        padded_input.data[idx_pad] = input.data[idx_in];
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        b = 0;
        while (b < batch) : (b += 1) {
            var out_c: usize = 0;
            while (out_c < out_channels) : (out_c += 1) {
                var out_h: usize = 0;
                while (out_h < out_height) : (out_h += 1) {
                    var out_w: usize = 0;
                    while (out_w < out_width) : (out_w += 1) {
                        var sum: f32 = 0.0;
                        var in_c: usize = 0;
                        while (in_c < in_channels) : (in_c += 1) {
                            var kh: usize = 0;
                            while (kh < kernel_height) : (kh += 1) {
                                var kw: usize = 0;
                                while (kw < kernel_width) : (kw += 1) {
                                    const input_h = out_h * stride_usize + kh;
                                    const input_w = out_w * stride_usize + kw;
                                    const idx_pad = b * in_channels * padded_h * padded_w + in_c * padded_h * padded_w + input_h * padded_w + input_w;
                                    const idx_kernel = out_c * in_channels * kernel_height * kernel_width + in_c * kernel_height * kernel_width + kh * kernel_width + kw;
                                    sum += padded_input.data[idx_pad] * kernel.data[idx_kernel];
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        const idx_out = b * out_channels * out_height * out_width + out_c * out_height * out_width + out_h * out_width + out_w;
                        output.data[idx_out] = sum;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return output;
    }

    pub fn maxPool2d(self: *const Tensor, kernel_size: u32, stride: u32) !Tensor {
        if (self.shape.len != 4) return error.InvalidShapeForPool;
        if (kernel_size == 0 or stride == 0) return error.InvalidStride;
        const batch: usize = @as(usize, self.shape[0]);
        const channels: usize = @as(usize, self.shape[1]);
        const height: usize = @as(usize, self.shape[2]);
        const width: usize = @as(usize, self.shape[3]);
        const out_height_u32: u32 = (self.shape[2] - kernel_size) / stride + 1;
        const out_width_u32: u32 = (self.shape[3] - kernel_size) / stride + 1;
        var out_shape: [4]u32 = .{ self.shape[0], self.shape[1], out_height_u32, out_width_u32 };
        var output = try Tensor.init(self.allocator, out_shape[0..]);
        const neg_inf = -math.inf(f32);
        mem.set(f32, output.data, neg_inf);
        const out_height: usize = @as(usize, out_height_u32);
        const out_width: usize = @as(usize, out_width_u32);
        const ksz: usize = @as(usize, kernel_size);
        const stride_usize: usize = @as(usize, stride);
        var b: usize = 0;
        while (b < batch) : (b += 1) {
            var c: usize = 0;
            while (c < channels) : (c += 1) {
                var out_h: usize = 0;
                while (out_h < out_height) : (out_h += 1) {
                    var out_w: usize = 0;
                    while (out_w < out_width) : (out_w += 1) {
                        var max_val: f32 = neg_inf;
                        var kh: usize = 0;
                        while (kh < ksz) : (kh += 1) {
                            var kw: usize = 0;
                            while (kw < ksz) : (kw += 1) {
                                const h = out_h * stride_usize + kh;
                                const w = out_w * stride_usize + kw;
                                if (h < height and w < width) {
                                    const idx = b * channels * height * width + c * height * width + h * width + w;
                                    if (self.data[idx] > max_val) max_val = self.data[idx];
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        const idx_out = b * channels * out_height * out_width + c * out_height * out_width + out_h * out_width + out_w;
                        output.data[idx_out] = max_val;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return output;
    }

    pub fn spectralRadius(allocator: Allocator, t: *const Tensor, max_iter: u32) !f32 {
        if (t.shape.len != 2 or t.shape[0] != t.shape[1]) return error.MustBeSquareMatrix;
        const n_u32 = t.shape[0];
        const n: usize = @as(usize, n_u32);
        var vec_shape: [2]u32 = .{ n_u32, 1 };
        var b = try Tensor.init(allocator, vec_shape[0..]);
        defer b.deinit();
        var prng = std.rand.DefaultPrng.init(0);
        const rand = prng.random();
        var i: usize = 0;
        while (i < n) : (i += 1) {
            b.data[i] = rand.float(f32);
        }
        var b_norm: f32 = 0.0;
        for (b.data) |val| b_norm += val * val;
        b_norm = math.sqrt(b_norm);
        for (b.data, 0..) |_, j| b.data[j] /= b_norm;
        var it: u32 = 0;
        while (it < max_iter) : (it += 1) {
            var ab = try matmul(allocator, t, &b);
            defer ab.deinit();
            var norm: f32 = 0.0;
            for (ab.data) |val| norm += val * val;
            norm = math.sqrt(norm);
            i = 0;
            while (i < n) : (i += 1) {
                b.data[i] = ab.data[i] / norm;
            }
        }
        var ab_final = try matmul(allocator, t, &b);
        defer ab_final.deinit();
        var result: f32 = 0.0;
        i = 0;
        while (i < n) : (i += 1) {
            result += b.data[i] * ab_final.data[i];
        }
        return result;
    }

    pub fn fillRandom(self: *Tensor, mean: f32, stddev: f32) void {
        var prng = std.rand.DefaultPrng.init(0);
        const rand = prng.random();
        for (self.data, 0..) |*val, _| {
            val.* = rand.floatNorm(f32) * stddev + mean;
        }
    }

    pub fn clone(self: *const Tensor) !Tensor {
        var result = try Tensor.init(self.allocator, self.shape);
        mem.copy(f32, result.data, self.data);
        return result;
    }

    pub fn reshape(self: *const Tensor, new_shape: []const u32) !Tensor {
        var new_size: usize = 1;
        for (new_shape) |d| new_size *= @as(usize, d);
        if (new_size != self.data.len) return error.ReshapeSizeMismatch;
        return Tensor{
            .allocator = self.allocator,
            .shape = try self.allocator.dupe(u32, new_shape),
            .data = try self.allocator.dupe(f32, self.data),
        };
    }

    pub fn argmax(self: *const Tensor, axis: u32) !Tensor {
        if (self.shape.len != 2) return error.NotImplementedForShape;
        const rows_u32 = self.shape[0];
        const cols_u32 = self.shape[1];
        const rows: usize = @as(usize, rows_u32);
        const cols: usize = @as(usize, cols_u32);
        var out_shape: [1]u32 = .{ rows_u32 };
        var result = try Tensor.init(self.allocator, out_shape[0..]);
        if (axis == 1) {
            var i: usize = 0;
            while (i < rows) : (i += 1) {
                var max_idx: usize = 0;
                var max_val = self.data[i * cols];
                var j: usize = 1;
                while (j < cols) : (j += 1) {
                    const val = self.data[i * cols + j];
                    if (val > max_val) {
                        max_val = val;
                        max_idx = j;
                    }
                }
                result.data[i] = @as(f32, @floatFromInt(max_idx));
            }
        } else {
            return error.NotImplementedForAxis;
        }
        return result;
    }
